summary: Getty Images Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing it is evaluating strategic financing alternatives and balance sheet management, with Guggenheim Securities as financial advisor. The company intends to use 30-day grace periods for interest payments on its 9.750% Senior Notes due 2027 and 14.000% Senior Notes due 2028, due September 1, 2026, despite having sufficient cash. This move is not an event of default. Majority equity holders are in discussions for a potential capital solution. Watch for a possible capital injection, noteholder negotiations, or restructuring; the grace-period election signals financial stress.
